SD19-X01.name: Ultimate-Siegfried
SD19-X01.effect:
[Summon Condition: You control one or more Red Spirits]

[Ultimate Trigger: [LV3][LV4][LV5] (When Attacks)]
When Ultimate Trigger hits, the opponent must block if possible. However, Ultimates don't have to block. If blocked by an opposing Spirit, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.
[utb]

[LV4][LV5] Flash - [True-Awaken] (When Attacks)
By sending a core from Spirits you control to this Ultimate, this Ultimate gains +3000 BP.

SD19-005.name: Edge-Wolf
SD19-005.effect:

SD19-015.name: Flame Spark
SD19-015.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. When this effect destroys any Spirit, return a Spirit card from the Trash to your Hand.

SD19-002.name: Mugendra
SD19-002.effect:

SD19-016.name: Neo-Flame Tempest
SD19-016.effect:
[Flash]

SD19-012.name: The Red Dawn Sky
SD19-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
If the first attack of the turn is made by your Ultimate, draw a card.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, destroy an opposing Nexus.

SD19-011.name: The Village of Hunters
SD19-011.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Attack Step)
All your Red Spirits/Ultimates gain +2000 BP.

[LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
When your Life is reduced by the opponent, destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. If you control any Ultimate, instead, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.
